text:
Predicates:
MovedTo(x, y) ::: x moved to y.
University(x) ::: x is a university.
IvyLeague(x) ::: x is an Ivy League institution.
ResearchUniversity(x) ::: x is a research university.
Yale(x) ::: x is Yale University.
Location(x, y) ::: x is located in y.

Premises:
Yale(x) ∧ Private(x) ∧ IvyLeague(x) ∧ ResearchUniversity(x) ::: Yale University is a private Ivy League research university.
MovedTo(yale, newHaven) ::: Yale University moved to New Haven.

Conclusion:
MovedTo(yale, newHaven)
